**1. 봉밀가 (강남구청점)**
- 2024년 기사에서는 이 곳이 2018년부터 해당 연도까지 미슐랭 빕 구르망에 빠짐없이 이름을 올렸고, 블루리본에도 7년 연속 선정되었다고 소개했습니다.
- 2026년 기사에서도 9년 연속 미쉐린 가이드에 선택된 메밀면이라는 점이 강조되었습니다.
- 육수는 한우 양지머리와 설깃살, 한약재를 넣고 다섯 시간 이상 끓여 만들며, 그릇 가득 넉넉하게 담아 준다고 합니다.

**2. 우래옥 (종로)**
- 서울 시내 최고의 평양냉면집이라는 평을 받는 곳으로 소개되었습니다. 진한 육향과 고소한 메밀면이 특징입니다.
- 2026년 기준 평양냉면 가격은 18,000원입니다(매일 11:20 – 21:00, 월요일 휴무).

**3. 서령 (회현/남대문)**
- 강화에서 인기가 많았던 평양냉면 전문점으로, 서울 남대문으로 이전했습니다.
- 대표 메뉴는 평양냉면의 정석 맛을 보여주는 서령 순면입니다.

**4. 청류 본점**
- 1++ 한우를 오랜 시간 끓여 깊은 육향을 낸 보양식 평양냉면으로 2026년 5월 기사에서 소개되었습니다.

**5. 진미평양냉면 (논현)**
- 20년 냉면 장인의 노하우로 만든 곳이며, 냉면과 함께 먹는 불고기가 유명합니다.

**6. 정인면옥 (영등포 본점)**
- 2026년 6월 기사에서 물냉면 가격은 1만 5천 원으로 소개되었습니다.

**참고 사항**
- 검색 결과에서 2026년 미쉐린 가이드 및 블루리본 최신 선정 목록은 확인되지 않았습니다. 블루리본은 블루리본 서베이 공식 사이트, 미쉐린은 미쉐린 가이드 서울 공식 사이트에서 올해 목록을 직접 확인하시기를 권합니다.
- 가격과 영업시간은 기사 작성 시점 기준이므로 방문 전에 변동 여부를 확인해 주세요.

Based on the search results, the strongest Pyongyang naengmyeon candidates in Seoul are Nampo Myeonok, Seoryeong, Jungin Myeonok, and Pildong Myeonok. I couldn't reach the official 2026 Michelin list, so treat these as secondary-source findings and confirm current award status on the Michelin Guide site before you go.

**Candidates**

- **Nampo Myeonok (Euljiro):** A travel blogger describes it as a Pyongyang naengmyeon specialist that has been consistently awarded a Michelin Bib Gourmand for nearly a decade. The same review says it is a quick 2-minute walk (about 0.1 miles) from Euljiro 1-ga Station. Its menu includes classic Pyongyang Naengmyeon (cold broth), Bibim Naengmyeon (spicy mixed), and Onmyeon (warm noodles).

- **Seoryeong (near Seoul Station/Namdaemun):** A separate blogger calls it one of Seoul's top 3 Pyongyang Naengmyeon spots. That is the blogger's own ranking, not an official one. The same review says it is on the Michelin Guide Seoul, and that it is incredibly popular among local office workers looking for a refreshing lunch near Seoul Station. Expect waits, though one reviewer notes that you can skip the physical line and walk right in.

- **Jungin Myeonok (Yeouido):** The Michelin-related listing describes it as a Bib Gourmand restaurant. It notes that the restaurant exclusively uses three-year-old natural sea salt and Korean beef to maintain the flavor of the broth for their signature Pyongyang naengmyeon. It also warns that expect a long wait during lunch hours as it is located in Yeouido.

- **Pildong Myeonok (Chungmuro):** Listed as a Bib Gourmand and a naengmyeon specialty. It has been serving Pyongyang cold buckwheat noodles for decades near Namsangol Hanok Village. Its broth is delicate, and reviewers disagree about whether that subtlety is a strength.

**Context for 2026**

- The 2026 guide covers Seoul and Busan together. One guide notes that the 2026 edition will be released in early March, so the listings above may reflect the 2025 edition plus later updates.
- One 2026 Seoul list that I found includes a long set of entries, but the portion I could read did not clearly show any naengmyeon restaurants, so I couldn't verify them from that source.
- A Seoul naengmyeon guide for 2026 notes that average bowls hit 12,538 won, so prices have risen.

**Recommendation:** For a classic Pyongyang-style bowl, Nampo Myeonok and Pildong Myeonok are the most consistently described as Michelin-recognized. Seoryeong is a good choice if you want a convenient location near Seoul Station. Check guide.michelin.com for the current 2026 Seoul listings and confirm opening hours and wait times before you visit.

content.text:
I couldn't find one current ranking of Seoul's Pyongyang naengmyeon restaurants, and I couldn't open the official 2026 Michelin Guide Seoul list. So by "best-rated" I mean places with a long record of Michelin Bib Gourmand recognition, which is Michelin's list of good-value restaurants. Check guide.michelin.com before you go to confirm each one is still listed this year.

1. **Nampo Myeonok (남포면옥), Euljiro.** A Pyongyang naengmyeon specialist that a 2026 review says has held a Bib Gourmand for nearly ten years. It's about a 2-minute walk from Euljiro 1-ga Station, and besides the classic cold-broth bowl it serves bibim naengmyeon and a warm noodle soup (onmyeon).
   Source: [Trvlogue – Nampo Myeonok Seoul Review 2026](https://www.trvlogue.com/en/nampo-myeonok-seoul-review)

2. **Bongmilga (봉밀가), Gangnam-gu Office branch.** It has been in the Michelin Bib Gourmand every year since 2018 and has also been picked for Korea's Blue Ribbon Survey restaurant guide many years running. The broth is Korean beef brisket and round simmered with medicinal herbs for over five hours. The magazine below is from 2024; a 2026 article says it has now been in the Michelin guide nine years in a row.
   Source: [Allure Korea – 연예인도 즐겨찾는 평양냉면 맛집 4](https://www.allurekorea.com/2024/05/28/%ec%97%b0%ec%98%88%ec%9d%b8%eb%8f%84-%ec%a6%90%ea%b2%a8%ec%b0%be%eb%8a%94-%ed%8f%89%ec%96%91%eb%83%89%eb%a9%b4-%eb%a7%9b%ec%a7%91-4/)

3. **Jungin Myeonok (정인면옥), Yeouido.** A Bib Gourmand restaurant that makes its broth with Korean beef and sea salt aged three years. Expect long lines at lunch, when the Yeouido office crowd comes in. A June 2026 article put a bowl of mul-naengmyeon at ₩15,000.
   Source: [ViaMichelin – Jungin Myeonok](https://www.viamichelin.pl/maps/restaurants/poi/seoul-07238-zgsqauwp)

**Other options:**
- **Woo Lae Oak (우래옥), Jongno:** often called the classic, with about ₩18,000 a bowl reported for 2026; it's closed Mondays.
- **Pildong Myeonok (필동면옥), Chungmuro:** also a Bib Gourmand, with a famously light broth.
- **Seoryeong (서령), near Seoul Station:** listed in the Michelin Guide.

Additional sources: [Trvlogue – Seoryeong](https://www.trvlogue.com/en/seoryeong-seoul-cold-noodles), [Daum (2026)](https://v.daum.net/v/20260630082125307)
